posts.body:
Has any one been before??  I went about 7 years but just for the day.
We are off a week on Thursday for 6 days but im not sure
how much money to take for me and Joseph
! I cant remember how expensive it is (but I think it is quite expensive)  We are staying Bed and Breakfast and our passes are included so really it is money for lunches and dinner etc and shopping!!! we think we might have a day into Paris as we are so close.
what do you think???
No idea how much $$$ but just wanted to say, hope you guys have a wonderful time!!!!!

Well tbh when I went it was their 5th anniversary! So a decade ago  😲
My parents took packed lunch and we sat in the picnic area...but with it being October I would think that would be quite a bad idea lol!
I remember there being a Main Street and past that was a few restaurants...I think maybe The HardRock cafe and a place you could have your meal with Micky and Minnie. I'm sure there were other outlets too, like McDonalds, but I think it was mainly fast food while we went. As far as I can remember the ice-cream was really expensive - about £1.10 each back then  🙃
We never ate in any restaurants while we were there so I'm not much help am I sorry  😉
I never actually went into Paris, but my parents went for my mums 40th a few years back and they said if you wanted a decent priced meal to go to the student area of Paris - but to be careful. Obviously the closer you are to the Tower and The Arc de Triumph the more stupid the prices are.
I will try to get some more info out of my mum and dad about the museums and I know they went up the tower but it was quite expensive.
